title: Railway RRB ALP & Technician Guide: CBT Stages, Trade Syllabus & CBAT Strategy
summary: Step-by-step roadmap for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) and Railway Technician recruitment by Railway Recruitment Boards across India.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) conduct national recruitment drives for Assistant Loco Pilots (ALP) and Technicians (Grade I Signal & Grade III Trades) across all 21 railway zones. As frontline running staff, Assistant Loco Pilots assist Loco Pilots in operating passenger, express, and freight trains, making it one of the most respected and dynamic technical careers in Indian Railways with lucrative running allowances.

## Eligibility Criteria

| Parameter | Requirements |
|---|---|
| **Educational Qualification (ALP)** | Matriculation / 10th pass PLUS ITI in relevant trade (Fitter, Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Millwright, Wireman, Tractor Mechanic, Turner, Machinist, Diesel Mechanic, etc.) OR 3-year Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering OR B.E. / B.Tech degree. |
| **Educational Qualification (Technicians)**| 10th pass + ITI in designated trade OR 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (for Technician Gr III Telecom/Signal) OR B.Sc / Diploma / Engineering for Technician Grade I Signal. |
| **Medical Fitness Category** | Must strictly meet **Medical Standard A-1** for ALP (Distant Vision: 6/6 without glasses, Near Vision: Sn: 0.6 without glasses, must pass color vision, binocular vision, field of vision, and night vision tests without refractive surgery). |
| **Nationality** | Citizen of India, subject of Nepal/Bhutan. |

## Age Limit & Relaxations

| Category | Age Range | Upper Age Relaxation |
|---|---|---|
| **General / EWS** | 18 - 30 Years (Extended up to 33 years in recent drives) | Nil (0 Years) |
| **OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)** | 18 - 30 Years | 3 Years (Up to 33/36 Years) |
| **SC / ST** | 18 - 30 Years | 5 Years (Up to 35/38 Years) |
| **Ex-Servicemen (ESM)** | 18 - 30 Years | 3 Years + military service duration |
| **Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)** | 18 - 30 Years | Relaxation up to apprentice training duration |

## Examination Structure & Stages

### Stage 1: First Stage CBT (CBT-1) - Screening Test
| Subject | Questions | Marks | Duration & Marking |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mathematics** | 20 Questions | 20 Marks | Total Time: 60 Minutes |
| **Mental Ability (Reasoning)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | Total Marks: 75 Marks |
| **General Science (Physics, Chem, Bio up to 10th)**| 20 Questions | 20 Marks | Negative Marking: 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **General Awareness on Current Affairs** | 10 Questions | 10 Marks | Qualifying minimum: UR-40%, OBC/SC-30%, ST-25% |

### Stage 2: Second Stage CBT (CBT-2) - Two Parts
| Part | Subject / Content | Questions | Time | Weightage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Part A** | Maths, Basic Science & Engineering, General Intelligence & Current Affairs | 100 Questions | 90 Minutes | **70% weightage** in final merit for ALP; 100% for Technicians |
| **Part B** | Relevant Trade Syllabus (DGT approved curriculum) | 75 Questions | 60 Minutes | **Qualifying only** (Mandatory 35% score across all categories) |

### Stage 3: Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho Test - ALP Only)
- Applicable solely for candidates who applied for ALP and cleared CBT-2 Part A & Part B.
- Evaluates memory, speed, perception, spatial visualization, and concentration across 5 battery tests (T-Score must be at least 42 in each battery test).
- **30% weightage** is given to the CBAT score in final ALP merit ranking.

## Step-by-Step Preparation Roadmap

| Phase | Recommended Action Plan |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Basic Science & Engineering Focus** | Study units and dimensions, work, power, energy, speed and velocity, basic electricity, levers and simple machines, engineering drawing (projections, views, instruments). This comprises 40+ marks in CBT-2 Part A. |
| **Phase 2: Trade Theory (DGT Syllabus)** | Revise your ITI/Diploma trade theory textbook (Bharat Skills portal questions). Solve previous year DGT trade exams to comfortably clear the 35% qualifying barrier in Part B. |
| **Phase 3: Mathematical Speed & Reasoning** | Master arithmetic, algebra, and geometry. Solve at least 30 calculation-intensive questions daily to maximize scoring in CBT-1 and CBT-2 Part A. |
| **Phase 4: RDSO Psycho Test Practice** | Practice online battery tests (Brick test, Memory test, Depth perception, Yes/No speed test) under tight time limits to guarantee high T-scores in each test battery. |

Maintaining eyesight and avoiding digital eye fatigue is vital for ALP aspirants. Combine consistent technical revision with eye rest to secure your loco pilot appointment.
